data.body:
Investigation before review — what the original plan asserted vs what the tree holds.

Correct as written: every line reference (compact_txn.py:522-654/196-223/633-637/297-326/329-454/401-415, compact_rebuild.py:107-238/59-84/76-79/164-195/88-103/198-205, compact_recovery.py:128-202, compact.py:176-225/228-283/314-350, compact_trigger.py:118-147), and both bug attributions (aea0 privileged-nephelite-colt added the fold's SNAPSHOT-exclusion filter; the rebuild had it from day one).

Wrong, and fixed in the description:
* Two named pinning tests do not exist at the paths given. They are tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_creation_channel_compaction.py and tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_rebuild_counter_b2bb.py, not tests/unit/.
* "rebuild gains rollback for free" and the SIGKILL acceptance criterion built on it were dropped. Bug e72e (compulsory-pernickety-mantis) scoped its journal + rollback design to the FOLD; the rebuild's crash model is the .snapshot-rebuild.bak sentinel plus an idempotent restart, and today a per-file rename failure there is logged while the rebuild still succeeds. Giving it abort-and-roll-back would change observable behaviour on a repair path, which the epic's consolidation guarantee forbids. Also: REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER is only reachable from compact_txn._retire_folded_sources, so the proposed "SIGKILL a rebuild at the existing barrier" criterion had nothing to fire it, and a SIGKILL runs no rollback code by definition.

Constraints found by grep that shaped the implementation (Serena cannot see them — they are monkeypatch string targets): tests/unit/test_compact_crash_atomicity.py patches _txn._retire_folded_sources, _txn._commit_compaction and calls _txn._rollback_fold directly, and src/rebar/_commands/leaf.py plus compact_trigger call compact._foldable_event_count. All four keep their names and signatures; only their internals now delegate.

Mutation evidence for the new tests (each perturbation applied to live code, the named test observed RED, then restored):
1. source_uuids_of stops excluding snapshots -> test_neither_engine_cites_a_consumed_prior_snapshot FAILED.
2. _is_event_file drops the .json requirement -> test_a_rebuild_ignores_a_stray_non_event_file FAILED ("a stray non-event file was retired by the rebuild").
3. needs_folding or -> and -> test_needs_folding_keeps_both_selection_arms FAILED.
4. restore_retired never records a failed rename -> test_restore_retired_reports_a_stuck_source FAILED.
5. _ENVELOPE_KEY_RE neutered -> test_the_scan_flags_an_envelope_builder FAILED.
6. Guard, all three directions: an unmarked second envelope in compact_trigger -> tree scan FAILED; the same line with a bare "# compact-plan-ok:" -> still FAILED; with "# compact-plan-ok: fixture writer" -> PASSED.

Line accounting for the epic's net-negative criterion: the five existing modules lose 169 non-test lines net (+120/-289); the new owner module is 328, so this child alone is +159. It is a new-owner child, so the negative sum has to come from the deletion-heavy children.

Gerrit change 2098.
